description.value: Oldhand Coffee is a family-owned specialty coffee cafe and bakery rooted in European hospitality traditions, operating two downtown BC locations in Abbotsford and Langley. Everything is baked in-house daily using local and seasonal ingredients, with a full espresso bar, house-made condiments, and a curated bottle shop of low-intervention wines and ciders. The Langley location, opened in March 2025, also offers a 1,500 sq ft upstairs event rental space with barista service.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 16m; stands (2 spaces) at 49m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Oldhand Coffee is an active, family-owned specialty cafe and bakery with two BC locations — 2617 Pauline St in Abbotsford and 20528 Fraser Hwy in Langley (opened March 2025). The OSM coordinates (49.10378, -122.6536958) map to Langley, so the Langley address is used. The menu explicitly labels several items as GF and/or vegan; no bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the website.
